limitations: The criterion is existential over positive conversion and mortality rates at fixed saturation and toxin-to-conversion ratio, not pointwise at each fixed parameter tuple.
All states of the constructed two-cycle are positive; the map is not asserted to preserve the full positive quadrant or to have an attracting two-cycle.
A relevant 2022 publication mentioning periodic points could only be assessed from its abstract; mathematical publication priority remains open.
title: A sharp toxin-to-conversion window for positive two-cycles in a Holling-II plankton map
